messages.subject: Specify variable as dataframe[index]?
parts:
It seems to me that supplying variables in ggplot2 functions requires
specifying the actual variable name in the working data frame. Is it
possible to specify the column index instead of the name?

For example, instead of using 'aes(y=Column2)', where "Column2" is the
name of the variable in the second column of the working data frame, I
would instead like to use something like 'aes(y=MyDataFrame[2])'.

Can it be done? I get an error when I run code like the above.

Many thanks,
Mauricio

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Specify variable as dataframe[index]?
parts:
Have you seen/tried using aes_string()? 

As an example, 

ggplot(data=data, aes_string(x=paste(colnames(data)[1]), y= paste(colnames(data)[2]))+geom_whatever()

B
